sentences: I preheat the oven to 350 degrees and wait for the indicator light to turn off.
I measure two cups of all-purpose flour and level it off with the back of a knife.
I sift the flour, baking powder, and salt together into a large mixing bowl.
I crack three eggs into a separate bowl and beat them with a fork.
I pour the milk and melted butter into the bowl with the eggs.
I mix the wet ingredients until they are combined and no streaks remain.
I pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir with a wooden spoon.
I grease a nine-inch round cake pan with shortening and dust it with flour.
I scrape the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula.
I place the pan on the center rack of the oven and close the door.
I set a timer for twenty-five minutes and check the cake through the glass door.
I insert a toothpick into the center of the cake to see if it comes out clean.
I remove the pan from the oven and set it on a wire cooling rack.
I let the cake cool in the pan for ten minutes before turning it out.
I mix powdered sugar, butter, and vanilla with a hand mixer until smooth.
I spread the frosting over the cooled cake with an offset spatula.
I shake sprinkles over the top of the frosted cake until it is covered.
I wash the mixing bowls, spatula, and measuring cups in hot soapy water.
I wrap the leftover cake in plastic wrap and store it in the refrigerator.
I wipe the counter with a damp cloth to remove flour and sticky batter.
